events.verdict: Jackson Jr. (MEM) moves into Zubac (LAC) to initiate the exchange, but both players are able to play through the contact and reach their intended spots on the floor.
Zubac (LAC) reaches forwards before attempting to retract his arm into a vertical position and the contact with Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) arm is marginal.
Wells (MEM) leans into Harden (LAC) and initiates the illegal contact between the two players. Any contact in response by Harden is preceded by the illegal contact by Wells.

Zubac (LAC) maintains a legal guarding position as he defend Jackson Jr. (MEM) in the post. The foul should have been called on Harden (LAC), who reaches in and makes illegal contact with Jackson Jr.'s arm.
Aldama (MEM) contests the dunk by Zubac (LAC) and the contact with Zubac's arm is marginal.
Dunn (LAC) moves laterally into Morant (MEM), affecting his SQBR during the drive to the basket.
Although Morant (MEM) loses his balance, he legally takes two steps before releasing the pass.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) heel is out of bounds when he receives the pass.
Bane (MEM) commits a take foul on Powell (LAC).
